categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
